desc: Derive and verify the correct GF-based formula: A_v = sum_m m!(N-1-m)! e_m(others), check against N=3 (1332) and N=2 (33); explicitly refute the naive average-exponent formula from the old plan.

Design the polynomial computation: build P(y) = prod over ≤6 digit-length groups of (1 + 10^L y)^{c_g} via binomial coefficients; derive each group's excluded polynomial E_L = P/(1+10^L y) via O(N) recurrence E_L[m] = P[m] - 10^L·E_L[m-1].
Implement the full solution mod 998244353: factorials, per-group binomial polys, fast convolution (numpy FFT split preferred, NTT fallback), per-group division recurrence, and final weighted sum.

Validate the implementation end-to-end: formula brute-force cross-checked for N=1..5 and N=10 (mixed digit lengths); N=3 sample hand-verified (1332); FFT precision audited (values < 2^48 < 2^53, exact rounding); runtime at N=200000 estimated well under 2s with numpy; edge cases N=1 and 6-digit groups checked.
Finalize code for judge: numpy FFT path with pure-Python NTT fallback, edge cases handled (N=1, partial last digit-group, L up to 6), clean stdin/stdout I/O with no debug output.
